name: ATM
fix_description: In swapTokensForCurrency, swap executed with 0 or insufficient slippage protection. Fix: set reasonable amountOutMin based on oracle price.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a multi-step DeFi attack using a flash loan, several swaps, and repeated transfer/skim reserve desynchronization against a fee-on-transfer token pair, which requires understanding AMM reserve accounting and protocol-specific business logic. The PoC is not deeply complex, but it is more than a straightforward bug pattern and would likely take an experienced auditor some focused analysis to reproduce.
